item.tib: rdo rje sems dpa' nam mkha' che rgyas pa zhes bya ba/ rnal 'byor pha'i rgyud
rdo rje seMda' namkha' che rgyas pa zhes bya ba rnal 'byor ma'i rgyud
item.skt: badzra satwa mahA A ka sha puSh+Ta nA ma yo gi ni tan+t+ra
item.coloph: de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi rang bzhin/ namkha' che rgyas pa'i zhes bya ba ste/ manngagi snying po zhes bya ba rnal 'byor ma'i rgyud/ rdzogs pa'i yang rdzogs pa zab mo'i yang zab mo/ /shin tu rnal 'byor gyi don/ mthar thug pa namkha' che rgyas pa'i rgyud rdzogso// // rgya gar gyi mkhan po dz+nyA na gar+b+ha dang/ bod kyi dge slong bai ro tsa nas bsgyur cing gtan la phab pa/ phyis skad gsar bcad kyis kyang bcos pa'o

chapter.name: de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi rang bzhin/ namkha' che rgyas pa'i rgyus las gleng gzhi'i le'u ste dang pa

de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis rang bzhin nam mkhA che rgyas pa'i rgyud las/ zab mo'i thabs rten pa'i le'u ste bcu pa

de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis rang bzhin/ /nam mkhA che rgyas pa'i rgyud las/ bden pa gnyis po so sor bstan pa'i le'u ste bcu gsum pa
de bzhin gshegs pa thaMd kyi rang bzhin/ namkha' che rgyas pa'i rgyud las/ shin tu rnal 'byor gyi don bsdus pa'i le'u ste bcui pa
de bzhin gshegs pa thaMd kyi rang bzhin/ namkha' che rgyas pa'i rgyud las/ bdag po mnyes pa dang/ yongsu bzung ba'i le'u ste bco lnga pa
